localFacts.fact: Canon Nederland lists the PowerShot V1 at 426 g, statiefbevestiging 1/4 (ISO 1222), and 'Statiefgrip HG-100TBR / HG-200TBR' among its accessories.
KLM allows 1 piece of hand baggage of max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm plus a small accessory under the seat; the Peak Design Travel Tripod folds to 39 cm.
Ryanair includes a small bag of 40 x 30 x 20 cm in every fare; the four minis fold to 18,5-22 cm.
Rijksmuseum refers to its general terms for photography, with as example: no tripods and no extra lighting.
Rijksmuseum Boerhaave in Leiden: photographing and filming is allowed, but without flash and without a tripod.
Dutch terms: statiefgrip, tafelstatief / ministatief, balhoofd, middenkolom, 1/4"-schroefdraad, flitsschoen; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: City trips: carrying a big tripod all day is not appealing.
localPainPoints.fix: A mini (PIXI Mini in a jacket pocket, MT-16 for 44 cm) covers most V1 shots; the Peak Design folds to 39 cm when standing height matters.

quotes.text: Vakanties zijn vooral stedentrips, dus een hele dag sjouwen en shoppen met een groot statief bij me, lijkt me geen goed idee.

localPainPoints.pain: A small ball head slowly tilts down when the camera hangs at an angle.
localPainPoints.fix: English post: centre the camera's weight over the head before locking, or use the PIXI EVO's -90° side tilt; keep a wide margin under the rated load.

quotes.text: Probeer een ruime marge aan te houden qua gewicht om te voorkomen dat de camera langzaam naar beneden kantelt.

localPainPoints.pain: Tripods are not allowed in many Dutch museums.
localPainPoints.fix: Check the house rules (Rijksmuseum, Boerhaave); film handheld with the V1's optical IS there.
